title: The Impact of Familiarity with Technology-Based Teaching Methods on the Acceptance of Online Learning Programs Among Business Students at Priviate Universities in Vietnam
reason: Mixed-methods technology-acceptance study: interviews, then a survey of 238 business students analysed with PLS-SEM. All constructs (familiarity, awareness, ease of use, acceptance) are self-reported; no platform-recorded indicator.
